rows.grounds: relating to the prājāpatya standard of measure
instrumental of the standard used for measurement
locative indicating the ritual pavilion as domain of application
locative indicating the sacred image as domain of application

items.question: What measurement standard governs the dimensions of both the pavilion and the sacred image?
premises: Specific linear measures such as vitasti and prādeśa have been defined previously.
The prājāpatya standard provides an authoritative basis for measurement.
Both the pavilion and the sacred image require regulated dimensions.
items.inference: Therefore the pavilion and the sacred image are to be measured according to the prājāpatya standard.
items.plain_english: By the prājāpatya measure, this applies to the pavilion and also to the sacred image.
